thread.title: Fresno County Sheriff arrests man for DUI and reckless driving after street racing incident
thread.title_full: Fresno County Sheriff arrests man for DUI and reckless driving after street racing incident

author: s. d. krause
title: Fresno County Sheriff arrests man for DUI and reckless driving after street racing incident
text:
A Fresno County Sheriff’s deputy arrested 21-year-old Josue Torres De La Torre of Fresno on June 20 after a street racing incident that ended with his vehicle disabled and evidence of intoxication.
According to the sheriff’s office, the arrest occurred shortly before 3:00 am when a deputy observed an Infiniti Q50 spinning donuts at the intersection of Clinton and Cornelia Avenues in Fresno. The deputy attempted a traffic stop, but De La Torre sped away, traveling a short distance in the wrong direction on Shields Avenue before hitting a curb and disabling his car. The deputy, along with assisting patrol units, contacted De La Torre and his three passengers at the scene.
Authorities said De La Torre showed signs of intoxication. A California Highway Patrol officer conducted a DUI investigation and determined that De La Torre was driving with a blood alcohol level more than three times the legal limit. Further investigation revealed that De La Torre was on probation for a previous DUI arrest and was required to have an ignition interlock device installed on any vehicle he drove.
De La Torre was booked into the Fresno County Jail on charges including evading police, reckless driving, street racing, and driving under the influence. He has since posted bond and been released from jail.
The sheriff’s office requests anyone with additional information about Josue Torres De La Torre to contact them at 559-600-3111 or Valley Crime Stoppers at 559-498-7867 or www.valleycrimestoppers.org. Callers may remain anonymous and could be eligible for a cash reward by referencing case #26-7212.
